title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
abstract: arXiv:2611.31113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $\tau = 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($\beta_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. translated_title: 注意力温度会混淆零样本上下文扩展的评估结果
translated_abstract: 训练时的注意力机制改动通常在默认温度 τ=1 下，通过与稠密基线在超出训练长度的零样本上下文扩展中的表现对比来进行评估。而评估结果取决于基线在该处失准（miscalibrated）的程度：即当其 logits 被单个标量锐化后所能恢复的困惑度比例。在标准训练配方（使用 fp32 主权重）下，在三组种子配对的 365M 孪生模型中，8k 长度训练的基线在 30k 处失准 8-15%；其中一组中，这使得块稀疏训练的孪生模型看起来好 7%，而校准可以消除这一差距。在无主权重的纯 bf16 训练中，失准程度要大数倍：在低于 1.7×10⁻³ 的峰值学习率下，对初始化为 1.0 的增益执行一次 AdamW 步骤（β₂=0.95）的更新量低于 bf16 数值间隔的一半，因此增益从未发生移动（共 22 个检查点），此时基线失准达 37-58%，而块稀疏预训练、注意力 dropout 和 ALiBi 看起来好 6-35%。校准……
tldr: 稠密基线的注意力温度校准状态会系统性歪曲零样本上下文扩展方法的评估结果，尤其在纯 bf16 训练中基线失准高达 37-58%，使块稀疏训练、注意力 dropout 和 ALiBi 等方法显得比实际更好，而校准后这些优势大多消失。
en_tdlr: The calibration state of a dense baseline's attention temperature confounds zero-shot context extension evaluation, especially in pure-bf16 training where the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, making block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout, and ALiBi appear 6-35% better than they actually are.
